text:
Lena V.: Hey everyone, day 1 for me on Payments-EU. I'm blocked on observability access. Need Datadog (service:payments-eu), Grafana view for payments-eu/main-dashboard, and Sentry project access for payments-prod. Email lena.v@redwood.ai. Also want to export a dashboard snapshot for a doc — is that allowed?
Jules (DevEx): Welcome Lena! :wave: Quick flow: Okta provisioning -> group observability-access (global) or region-specific group observability-eu. If you don't see groups file an identity request. Snapshot exports are allowed but we prefer to use Grafana snapshots that are internal (no public links) for docs.
Lena V.: I can't see observability-eu in Okta. My Okta shows only default groups. Filed identity request REQ-210555 with scope: grafana:viewer, datadog:standard, sentry:member and justification "onboard + pager duty ramp".
okta-bot: Request REQ-210555 created. Manager approval pending. Approve at https://idp.redwood/requests/210555
Omar (Platform): Tagging in — which org/namespace? We have separate EU namespaces for logs and metrics. Also confirm if you need write on Grafana or just view + snapshots.
Lena V.: Org: redwood-eu-payments. Only need view + snapshot export for a short doc. No edit perms required.
infra-bot: Datadog invite queued for lena.v@redwood.ai (expires in 48h). Invite ref: 1845678912-INV. Track at https://idp.redwood/invites/1845678912
Riya (SRE): For Datadog SLOs and monitors: they live under tag service:payments-eu and team:payments. If you don't see monitors check the "scope" filter in the monitors list. For alert runbooks see https://runbooks.redwood/payments/eu/alerts.
Lena V.: Manager approved the request.
okta-bot: Identity REQ-210555 status: approved. Provisioning starting.
security-bot: Policy reminder: EU access requires MFA + device attestation and company-managed disk encryption. Enroll Okta Verify and register your device at https://idp.redwood/devices.
Lena V.: Enrolled Okta Verify and device approved.
Jules (DevEx): Sentry invite sent — please accept within 48h. For Grafana I've provisioned view access to the payments folder; you should see payments-eu/main-dashboard. For snapshots, use the built-in snapshot button and pick "internal" scope.
Lena V.: I still get a 403 when trying to view payments-eu/main-dashboard in the web UI. Error banner says "Not authorized to view folder".
Omar (Platform): Hmm. Did the folder inherit permissions from the team? I'll check. Can you paste the full URL?
Lena V.: URL: https://grafana.internal/d/payments-eu/main-dashboard?orgId=5
Omar (Platform): Thanks. Looks like the folder owner blocked group-level access for that folder. I've added observability-eu as viewer to the folder and restarted the provisioning job. It may take a minute.
infra-bot: Provisioning update: Grafana folder permissions applied for lena.v@redwood.ai.
Lena V.: Now I can see the dashboard, thanks! Can someone confirm I can export a snapshot for internal docs? I see the snapshot button but it warns about sharing.
Jules (DevEx): Internal snapshots are fine — choose "Create internal snapshot" and don't check "Make public". If you need a static PNG we recommend using the export panel -> PNG option or the API: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN" https://grafana.internal/render/d-solo/payments-eu/main-dashboard?panelId=2&width=1000&height=500
```
Lena V.: Got it. Sentry invite accepted and I can see release health. Datadog invite link didn't arrive though.
infra-bot: Datadog invite resend queued for lena.v@redwood.ai. Invite ref: 1845678912-INV-2
Riya (SRE): If Datadog still doesn't show monitors after invite, check that your Datadog account is linked to the EU tenant (datadog.eu). Sometimes EU accounts are created under global and need re-linking. Ping me if it's still missing.
Lena V.: Datadog access arrived, monitors visible. One last Q: where do on-call handoffs and playlists live? I want to add a playlist link to our KB.
Jules (DevEx): We keep playlists at /playlists/payments-oncall in Grafana and a short handoff checklist in the Payments team KB: https://kb.redwood/payments/oncall-checklist. If you want, I can add you to the playlist so it shows up in your Grafana sidebar.
Lena V.: Please add me to the playlist. Also who owns the payment error-rate alert runbook? I want to review it.
Riya (SRE): I own that runbook. Link: https://runbooks.redwood/payments/eu/error-rate. Feel free to review and ping me if anything is unclear.
Lena V.: Awesome, I can see everything now and exported an internal snapshot for the onboarding doc. Thanks all :tada:
Jules (DevEx): Welcome aboard! If you want a 10m tour later today I can screen-share the key dashboards and alert flows.
Lena V.: Would love that, thanks!
